newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower, seen stable.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended slightly weaker on Wednesday as major banks continued to liquidate excess funds, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 5.718 percent against Tuesday's 5.751 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.70-5.75 percent agaisnt 5.70-5.80.
The rates were expected to hold around current levels on Thursday, dealers said.
The bond market reported active trade, with the 10-year 86/4 bond yield at 6.105.
